Maria R.: Quick follow-up: we need owners and dates for the KV-cache OOM postmortem. propose three buckets: repro/profiling, runtime mitigations, ops/runbooks.
Alex T.: I'll own repro + nightly heap dumps. will add jemalloc metrics to dashboards.
Jamal S.: I'll run GC and compaction experiments and try a small off-heap cache prototype.
Ingrid L.: Ops will add new alerts and canary gating. propose soft watermark at 65% host mem, hard at 80%.
Patrick H.: Devex: I'll produce a cost table for TTL changes and add ticket templates.
sre-bot: Incident INF-2410 resolved; follow-ups required by Maria R.
Maria R.: Deliverables: EOW heap-diff, week 2 GC results, week 3 RCA verification + recurring 90-day watch.
Alex T.: Early finding: repeated small inserts after large-sequence reads increase fragmentation. sample `mallinfo` shows retained growth ~200MB.
Jamal S.: Repro PR drafted: feeds 50k small keys + interleaved large reads. opening INF-2411 for repro + logs.
Ingrid L.: Alert rule draft: if 2 hosts in a zone have kv_cache_rss_ratio > 0.78 for 5m -> SEV2 + auto-snapshot.
Patrick H.: I'll attach a cost delta estimate in INF-2412. lowering TTL by 50% estimated to increase request compute cost by ~10%.
Alex T.: Short mitigation: shard-local eviction on pressure; low-risk prototype this week.
Jamal S.: GC tuning plan: background purging every 10m and MALLOC_TRIM_THRESHOLD tweaks. rollback if latency >5% or no frag improvement.
Maria R.: Ownership recap: Alex INF-2411, Jamal INF-2413, Ingrid INF-2414, Patrick INF-2412. post sprint plans by EOD Tue. weekly 30m check-ins Fridays for 3 weeks.
Alex T.: granted read-only jemalloc metrics access acknowledged.
Jamal S.: posting repro link to INF-2411 by EOD.
Ingrid L.: I'll update runbook steps for safe shard drain and heap-dump capture commands.
Maria R.: thanks team. I'll publish the follow-up board and calendar invites. close this thread after first check-in.
